meta.metric: ambiguous counted by DECLARATIONS (distinct-file declarations), not distinct kinds; the five classes are about the TARGET'S MATCH, and they partition the edges exactly
meta.direction: resolved/external are FLOORS (may not decrease). ambiguous/otherUnresolved/unclassed are CEILINGS (may not increase). The classes are siblings that partition the edges: edges = resolved + ambiguous + otherUnresolved + external + unclassed, and the last of those is checked to be 0 rather than assumed.
meta.theBiasInThisMeasurement: THE EDGE COUNTS ARE THE POPULATION'S, EXACTLY: every admitted file is measured exactly once across the five slices, and an edge is a per-file fact. THE RESOLUTION BUCKETS ARE THE CHUNKED MEASUREMENT'S, AND THEY CARRY A BIAS THE GATE'S OWN POPULATION LINE NAMES: "A stride sample truncates each project's symbol table too, so its project-scoped RESOLVED share is biased UP — a name whose collision lives in an unsampled file of the same repository reads unique here." ⇒ THE `resolved` CLASS IS BIASED UPWARD AND THE `ambiguous` AND `otherUnresolved` CLASSES ARE BIASED DOWNWARD, relative to a whole-population run in one project scope. The mechanism is a repository that STRADDLES a slice boundary: the half that is not in the slice cannot see the collisions in the other half, so a name that would be ambiguous reads unique and the edge resolves. THE STRADDLE CONTROL (script/m14/html-straddle-control.sh) MEASURES THE SIZE of the effect on one repository of this population, whole against split, over the same files — and its result is read HERE, so this note can only claim what the control has measured. THE CONTROL IS INSTRUMENTED AND NOT YET RUN — the small slot is fleet-wide and one lane at a time, so no number is claimed here. Instrument: script/m14/html-straddle-control.sh; artifact when it lands: validation/m14/measurements/html-straddle/vault-straddle.json.

notes: THE DECLARATION IS GENERATED by script/m14/html-declaration.ts FROM THE MEASUREMENT, and it is REWRITTEN whenever the measurement is re-run: a hand-written declaration is a claim whose numbers can drift from the measurement while its prose still reads correctly.

THE FIVE CLASSES PARTITION THE EDGES, AND THE PARTITION IS CHECKED HERE, PER TYPE AND IN TOTAL: the generator REFUSES to write a declaration whose classes do not sum to the measured edge count, and refuses one whose `unclassed` is not 0.

THE BINDING AND CAUSE BUCKETS ARE `otherUnresolved` AND NOT `unclassed`: a binding-spelled target (`<callable>:<binding>`) names no declaration, and a declared cause is stated rather than claimed — neither is an edge the instrument failed to classify.
A CEILING IS A CLAIM ABOUT WHAT IS KNOWN AND ACCEPTED, NEVER THAT THE CLASS IS FINE. Repaying a cluster means lowering its ceiling in the same commit that lowers the number.

★ THE COLLISION IS THE LANE'S OWN SHAPE, AND IT IS DISCLOSED HERE RATHER THAN LEFT IN THE TABLE. The gate's TABLE 1 prints `collRes` — of `resolved`, the targets that had MORE THAN ONE declaration, so production's tie-break chose the row — and it says the indexer measures 37,318 of 49,729 such picks as WRONG. MEASURED OVER THIS POPULATION: the collision is ENTIRELY IN `contains` — 148,544 of its 168,818 resolved edges (88.0%), and 0 in every other type. ⇒ THE HTML LANE'S `contains` EDGES ARE ELEMENT-NAME EDGES (a `div` contains a `span`), AND AN ELEMENT NAME IS NOT A UNIQUE SYMBOL WITHIN A PROJECT: every `div` in a project declares the name `div`. ⇒ SO A RESOLVED `contains` EDGE SAYS 'THERE IS A `div` IN THIS PROJECT', NOT 'THIS IS THE `div`' — and the reader of the number must know that before the number is read as a symbol-to-symbol resolution. It is a property of the LANE'S GRAMMAR, not of this corpus, and it is the lane's own to account for.

THE HTML LANE IS A CONTAINER: it has a MARKUP grammar and it merges in an embedded-script delegate's relationships verbatim (src/ast/real-html-analyzer.ts:2003). The four types it publishes through that seam (decorates, implements, renders, mixes_in) are therefore EXPRESSIBLE, and each is pinned by a behavioural fixture with a FIRED negative control; the population simply does not exercise them.
